answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure computational infeasibility of identity cloning; an adversary attempting to clone identities will wander into an exponentially large search space, akin to trying to find an ember in a vast willow forest, thereby guaranteeing information-theoretic unforgeability and Byzantine fault tolerance, ultimately yielding a cryptographically secure framework for autonomous agent interactions.
